fusions.name: Barb Torn Free
fusions.desc: Twists a barb into the target and rips it out, dealing 16 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Grapple and Winch
fusions.desc: Casts a hook at a target up to 7 tiles away and winches you to it. The hook deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Winding Line
fusions.desc: Sets a hooked line ahead of you for 6 seconds that winds every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Snagged and Spun
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, your next strike has 12% more critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.
